note: Ground snapping for terrain_town (placed at the world origin). heights[j][i] = glTF y of the terrain surface at vertex x = x0 + i*cell, z = z0 + j*cell (bilinear between vertices is within a few cm of the mesh; the mesh is 2 m triangles). walkable[j][i] = class of the cell [x0+i, x0+i+1] x [z0+j, z0+j+1]. Bridge cells: height comes from the bridge asset, not heights[].
